Dear Dua Restaurant Team,

I recently came across Dua Restaurant on Tripadvisor and Facebook. With multiple branches across Karachi — Mauripur Road, Clifton, and Highway — and over 15,000 Facebook followers, it is clear that Dua has built a strong reputation, especially for authentic Peshawari and Afghani lamb dishes.

But here is what I noticed:

Dua Restaurant has no proper website. And on Tripadvisor, your listing is unclaimed — meaning you have no control over what customers see when they search for you.

For a restaurant with your following and multiple branches, this is a gap worth fixing — and it does not have to be expensive.

Here is what a low-cost website + Google presence package would include:

 A clean, professional website — menu, photos, branch locations, and contact numbers
 Google My Business setup for all branches — appear on Google Maps when customers search nearby
 Tripadvisor listing claimed and updated — respond to reviews, add photos, control your profile
 SEO basics — so "Afghani restaurant Karachi" or "Dumbba karahi Karachi" searches lead to Dua
 WhatsApp order button — customers message directly from the website

Right now, a customer searching for your restaurant on Google sees incomplete information and no website. A competitor with a proper online presence will win that customer instead of you.

This is a straightforward, affordable fix — and I can show you a free mockup of what your website would look like before you commit to anything.

Can we schedule a 15-minute call this week?

Best regards,
Syed Mesum Ali Shah
Founder of Cortech Solution

Dear Abubaker Bilal,

Zahid Nihari needs no introduction. Since 1980, you have been serving Karachi's most iconic nihari and the world has taken notice. Being ranked 89th on TasteAtlas' list of the Most Iconic Food Places in the World is not just an achievement, it is a testament to over four decades of dedication.

But here is something worth thinking about:

You have thousands of loyal customers. people who drive across Karachi every Sunday just for your special nihari, families who have been coming for generations. Yet right now, none of them can place an order from home. There is no loyalty reward for your most faithful regulars. And when you have a special offer or a seasonal dish, there is no direct way to let your customers know.

That is the gap we can close for you.

What we would build:

 Online ordering system — customers order from home, no phone calls needed
 Loyalty program — points on every order, special rewards for your regulars
 WhatsApp & SMS notifications — announce your Sunday special, Eid offers, or new dishes directly to customers
 Delivery integration — your own system alongside Foodpanda, all in one place
 Customer database — know exactly who your most loyal customers are

Zahid Nihari's taste has been recognized by the world. The right technology will bring that experience to even more people without changing a single thing about what makes you special.

I would love to put together a free proposal tailored specifically for Zahid Nihari. Can we schedule a 15-minute meeting this week?

Warm regards,
Mesum ali
Founder of Cortech Solution
